decisions.decision: Market/good identifier columns use INTEGER, not BIGINT
decisions.why: market ids are a small 184-entry index space; only population/wars needed BIGINT after a proven INT32 overflow against the real save, and no similar evidence exists here
decisions.rejected: defaulting to BIGINT defensively for every new entity table

decisions.decision: markets table stores only member_count, not the member-location list
decisions.why: no FR reads individual member locations, only the count (FR-003)
decisions.rejected: a normalized market_members(market_idx, location_idx) join table

decisions.decision: Market display name derived via COALESCE(provinces.name, 'Location '||idx, 'Market '||market_idx)
decisions.why: reuses listProvincesArrow's existing location-naming pattern plus one fallback for the spec's no-resolvable-center edge case
closest name-match to raw materials/buildings/trade; to be verified against the real fixture before shipping extraction logic
clean match to spec's five buckets, with Trade+BurgherTrades merged since spec has one trade bucket
decisions.rejected: using taken.* (sparser, ~66% coverage) instead of demanded.*

decisions.decision: Price history dates computed once at extraction time from save's current date, stored as an explicit date column
decisions.why: goods.<good>.history is a bare number list with no embedded dates; computing once keeps every consumer working with real dates instead of re-deriving cadence/anchor logic independently
decisions.rejected: storing raw list position only and computing dates client-side in every consumer

decisions.decision: World Production Total read directly from market_manager.produced_goods.<good>, never summed client-side
decisions.why: it's a distinct save-provided snapshot figure, not necessarily equal to a naive sum of market_goods
decisions.rejected: deriving world totals by SUM() over market_goods

decisions.decision: Mid-plan scope addition at explicit user direction: introduce Apache ECharts as this app's charting library, retrofitting the already-shipped LeaderboardChart.tsx and LeaderboardTreemap.tsx alongside the new MarketGoodPriceChart.tsx, via one new shared useEChartsInstance hook
decisions.why: user directive to consolidate charting on ECharts; confirmed ECharts' treemap supports per-node itemStyle.color, resolving the exact limitation that originally forced LeaderboardTreemap's hand-rolled approach; recorded as a justified Principle VII violation in plan.md's Complexity Tracking, and spec.md's charting Assumption corrected to match
decisions.rejected: hand-rolled SVG for the new chart only, leaving Leaderboard's two hand-rolled charts as a third divergent implementation

decisions.decision: New echarts dependency consumed via a thin custom useEChartsInstance hook, not the echarts-for-react wrapper package
decisions.why: mirrors this codebase's existing preference for owning its own React-integration layer over a raw library, shared across exactly the three call sites that need it
decisions.rejected: adding echarts-for-react as a second dependency layer

decisions.decision: is_importing/is_exporting stored as INTEGER 0/1, not a native BOOLEAN column
decisions.why: insertRows' bulk Arrow-insert path only accepts string/number/null per row, and this schema has no BOOLEAN column anywhere else (nations.is_player sets the 0/1 precedent) -- discovered while implementing T006, not anticipated in planning

decisions.decision: market_manager's per-market member-location count sourced from the `members` field, not the sibling `market`/`migration` list fields
decisions.why: closest name-match for "locations belonging to this market"; flagged in research.md for re-verification against a real full save since the inventory scan alone couldn't disambiguate the three similarly-shaped list fields
decisions.rejected: the `market` field (also a list of location ids, ambiguous purpose)

decisions.decision: PerspectiveViewer row-selection resolved via its documented onClick prop (subscribes to the underlying element's perspective-click event), with idx added as a visible grid column since the click payload only carries config.columns
decisions.why: source-confirmed against @perspective-dev/viewer-datagrid's actual event dispatch, not guessed from types -- this was research.md's one flagged open risk for User Story 1, resolved during implementation
decisions.rejected: a custom click handler over the raw DOM (unnecessary once the real API was found)

decisions.decision: Mock the shared useEChartsInstance hook in all ECharts-based component tests (MarketGoodPriceChart, LeaderboardChart, LeaderboardTreemap) and assert on the built option object directly, rather than asserting on real rendered SVG output
decisions.why: real ECharts layout is meaningless under jsdom's zero-size container (confirmed: a 2-node treemap only draws its larger box at 0x0) -- discovered while retrofitting LeaderboardTreemap's integration test
decisions.rejected: asserting against real rendered pixel/DOM output, which proved unreliable in jsdom

plan.summary: Phase 0/1 design complete: market_manager ingestion mapped to 4 new tables + 4 query functions, plus a mid-plan scope addition (user-directed) to adopt Apache ECharts app-wide, retrofitting Leaderboard's two hand-rolled charts alongside the new price-history chart.
plan.key_finding: market_manager.database has no name field (184 markets, name must be derived) and goods.<good>.history has no embedded dates (must be computed at extraction time); ECharts' per-node itemStyle.color resolves the exact Perspective-plugin limitation that originally forced LeaderboardTreemap's hand-rolled implementation.

tasks.summary: 28 tasks across 6 phases (Setup, Foundational data layer + shared ECharts hook, 3 user-story phases, Polish including a mid-plan ECharts retrofit of Leaderboard's chart+treemap).

implement.summary: Markets page shipped end to end: market_manager parser ingestion, 4 new tables/queries, full US1-US3 drill-down UI, plus a mid-plan ECharts charting-library consolidation retrofitting Leaderboard's chart and treemap. 274/274 tests pass, tsc clean, production build succeeds.

approach: Extend the 1.3.11 parser adapter to ingest market_manager into 4 new tables mirroring nations/nation_history/population conventions, expose via 4 new list*Arrow query functions, and build the Markets UI from PerspectiveViewer grids (list views) plus a new ECharts-based price chart -- with a user-directed mid-plan addition to also retrofit Leaderboard's two hand-rolled charts onto ECharts via one shared hook.

concerns.note: Full browser click-through of the Markets page with real loaded data wasn't achievable in this sandbox: the only available save fixture (tests/fixtures/rus-1628-minimal.eu5) deliberately has no resolvable player nation (a pre-existing, unrelated app requirement in src/storage/queries.ts, not something this feature introduced), so the app's top-level load flow rejects it before reaching Factbook. Verified instead via 274 passing automated tests spanning the real parser/schema/query/decode/component chain (including 5 parser tests and 4 storage tests against this exact fixture's real market_manager data), plus a real dev-server load confirming the new echarts dependency doesn't break app startup and the Markets tab's FR-010 idle state renders correctly. Recommend a manual click-through with a real full save before considering this fully user-verified.

Supply/demand field mapping (production_supplied.RawMaterials/Buildings + supplied.Trade for the 3-way supply split; demanded.Trade+BurgherTrades merged for the 5-way demand split) is based on field-name inference against a single reference save's inventory scan, not confirmed against multiple real saves or in-game documentation -- flagged in research.md as needing verification when a second real save becomes available.
